# Spellings the scorer treats as the SAME word (asr-eval.ts), one `variant = canonical` per line.
# Add only genuine equivalents (colloquial vs standard spelling). Do NOT add real
# mishearings (e.g. Filippense = Filippenzen) -- those are the errors we measure.
# Both sides are normalised first (lowercase, no diacritics/apostrophes/hyphens,
# digits as words), so write them in plain lowercase.
goeie = goede
comma = komma
d'r voor = ervoor
